facts.text: John expressed that they are still sad about losing Max but find comfort in the good times and memories they had with him.

evidence.quote: Hey Maria, thanks for the kind words. We're all still sad about it, but have been comforted by the good times we had and the memories we have.
The toughest thing to deal with is that we had to say goodbye to Max. He was such an important part of our family for 10 years and it's so hard to think he's not here wagging that tail anymore.

facts.text: Maria acknowledged that John is finding comfort in the good times with Max and mentioned that pets have a way of touching our hearts.

evidence.quote: Good to hear that you're finding comfort in the good times you had with Max. Pets really have a way of touching our hearts.

facts.text: John shared a picture of Max, who is depicted in the photo sitting in the grass with a leash.

evidence.quote: Here's a picture of him that I cherish.
Max looks so peaceful in that photo, just chilling in the backyard.

facts.text: Maria commented that Max looks peaceful in the photo and suggested that remembering him in this way is a great way to honor him.

evidence.quote: Max looks so peaceful in that photo, just chilling in the backyard. It's nice to remember him like that. It's a great way to honor him.
